rationale: The short thesis required price below the 5m 9-EMA, but BLK has now reclaimed it ($1069.39 vs 9-EMA $1068.44) with five consecutive rising 1m candles off the $1064.09 low, and last price is only ~$1.11 from the $1070.50 invalidation.
